integration_rules: When runtime compatibility matters, resolve CURRENT and LAST_FULLY_VERIFIED separately from the Flashcards repo.
Target CURRENT for new runtime integration even if CURRENT has blockers or incomplete verification.
Never retarget integration to LAST_FULLY_VERIFIED solely because it is fully verified.
Use LAST_FULLY_VERIFIED only for regression/fallback comparison.
A blocker on CURRENT may block final acceptance but does not change the integration base.
If CURRENT advances, content runtime-acceptance work must re-resolve and target the newer CURRENT before PASS.
Before proposing a Git/process automation change, consult PROJECT-MEMORY.json and surface any conflicting prior incident/decision.

After each validated Flashcards CURRENT update, source/metadata sync is attempted before handoff. If bounded sync attempts fail, portable CURRENT remains authoritative and Git persistence is marked PENDING without downgrading.
